validity.recommendation: Reclassify PipelineType from 'transmission' to a feeder/distribution lateral, or reassess whether this 1.2 km single-consumer spur meets the GGIT transmission-inclusion threshold at all.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE is confirmed: two publications independently describe a 1,200 m dry-gas line built by the Oil Pipelines Company (OPC) to supply the Al-Najaf Al-Ashraf cement factory, commissioned 17 Dec 2023 (INA, ninanews.com Key=1095768 and Key=1095770, Arabic) and reported Jan 2024 (globalcement.com item 16753, English). CLASSIFICATION is the problem: the source's own wording is 'انبوب الغاز الجاف المغذي' = 'the dry-gas FEEDER pipeline', and both articles describe a 1.2 km dedicated spur delivering gas to ONE cement plant. GEM records PipelineType='transmission'. A 1.2 km, 10-inch dedicated lateral to a single industrial consumer is a feeder/distribution lateral, not a gas transmission trunk, and is well below typical GGIT transmission scope. Note the wiki page is supported by a SINGLE citation (globalcement item 16753, backlinks=6) — a thin evidentiary base, though INA corroborates independently.

validity.recommendation: Change Owner1 from 'Iraq Ministry of Oil' to the plant-owning cement company (Iraqi General Company for Cement / State Co. for Southern Cement, Ministry of Industry & Minerals); verify whether OPC actually OPERATES the line or was only the EPC builder.
validity.researcher_notes: OPC executed the line as its 'first EPC contract for the benefit of another company' (INA) — i.e. OPC was the design/build contractor, and under an EPC hand-over the asset belongs to the client cement plant, not to OPC/Ministry of Oil. The Al-Najaf Al-Ashraf (Kufa) cement plant is a state facility under the Ministry of Industry & Minerals (Iraqi General Company for Cement / southern-cement.com, icsc.industry.gov.iq). GEM's Owner1='Iraq Ministry of Oil' (100%) is therefore likely wrong — the owner is the cement company under Industry, not Oil. Operator='Oil Pipelines Co' is defensible only if OPC retained O&M; the sources call OPC the builder, not the operator, so the Operator field is also uncorroborated (its [ref] is blank in the worklist). Owner [ref] currently points to ninanews Key=1095770 which does NOT name Ministry of Oil.

validity.recommendation: Remove the orphan Diameter [ref] (iraqieconomists PDF does not name this pipeline); re-source diameter=10 in to INA. Fix the 404 Start [ref] and reconcile StartYear1 (commissioned 17 Dec 2023 per INA, so 2023 not 2024).
validity.researcher_notes: SPEC check: (1) Length 1.2 km / 1200 m — CONFIRMED by globalcement (verifier-passed on token '1200') and INA. High confidence. (2) Diameter 10 in — the current Diameter [ref] is https://iraqieconomists.net/.../Al-Jibawi.pdf, but that PDF does NOT contain 'Najaf' or 'cement' (confirmed by reading it); url_verifier only 'passed' it on the generic token '10', a coincidental match — it is an ORPHAN/mismatched citation and must be dropped. Diameter=10 in IS supported by INA ('انبوب الغاز الجاف قياس 10' inches, Key=1095768), but ninanews is JS-rendered and fails url_verifier, so no verifier-passing URL for the diameter exists — UNRESOLVED ref. (3) Start [ref] is a globalcement itemlist tag URL that 404s; and INA gives completion 17 Dec 2023, so StartYear1=2024 is off by one (2024 is the reporting date). (4) Capacity is blank — no public figure for a single-plant feeder; left blank (do not force). (5) Fuel=Gas ('dry gas') and Status=operating (commissioned Dec 2023) both confirmed by globalcement.

fills.researcher_notes: globalcement item 16753 states the line is 1,200 m (=1.2 km); verifier passed on token '1200'. INA (Key=1095768/1095770) independently gives 1,200 m but is JS-rendered and cannot pass url_verifier. Replaces the value-check that failed only on the '1.2' formatting token.

The existing Diameter [ref] (iraqieconomists Al-Jibawi PDF) is an ORPHAN: the PDF contains neither 'Najaf' nor 'cement' and never names this pipeline — its earlier url_verifier pass was a coincidental match on the bare token '10'. It must be removed. Diameter=10 in is corroborated only by INA (ninanews Key=1095768, 'قياس 10' inch), which is JS-rendered and fails url_verifier, so no verifier-passing URL is available. Left UNRESOLVED rather than citing an unverifiable or mismatched source.

routes.corridor_desc: Very short (~1.2 km) local dry-gas feeder lying entirely within Najaf (Al-Najaf) governorate, running from an undisclosed offtake on the local gas supply to the Al-Najaf Al-Ashraf / Kufa cement plant. Neither source discloses the offtake point or a routed alignment, so the corridor can only be bounded to 'within ~1.2 km of the cement plant in the Kufa/Najaf area.' Endpoint precision is further limited by a naming ambiguity between two Najaf-governorate cement facilities (the state-owned Kufa Cement Plant vs. the KAR-operated Najaf Cement Plant); I could not independently (non-GEM) fix which one, nor source a precise plant coordinate, so endpoint lat/lon are left null rather than fabricated.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from globalcement item 16753 + INA (Key=1095768/1095770): destination is the Al-Najaf Al-Ashraf cement plant; source offtake undisclosed. Only a city-level Najaf/Kufa anchor (~31.99N, 44.33E) is defensible; precise endpoint coordinates were NOT fabricated — left null because I could not independently source them without relying on gem.wiki, and the two-plant naming ambiguity is unresolved. A human routes-repo branch should confirm which cement plant and the offtake point.

summary: P7468 is real but MISCLASSIFIED: a 1.2 km 10-in dry-gas FEEDER (المغذي) to a single Najaf cement plant, tagged transmission; owner likely wrong (Ministry of Industry cement co, not Ministry of Oil); Diameter [ref] PDF is an orphan that never names the line.
